decisions.reason: The black-finish range sits close to the core offer, and its visibility rose to a dedicated page in 2024, which suggests results meet the aspiration level at low marginal cost, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.

The seamless-covering shower channel has had its own page in both years and fits the firm's barrier-free bathroom strategy, so steady performance and available slack in a growing industry favour keeping it.

The pump-drain channel is new and its results are still uncertain, and the earlier pump solution C was withdrawn, but F appears to be its refined successor, so slack and a short track record argue for giving it more time.
